name: Claude
description: Claude Code by Anthropic: chat with Claude inside the editor. It works on your models in its own tab through the editor's MCP server.

signIn.label: Sign in with Claude (Pro / Max subscription)…
signIn.tip: Sign in with your Claude account (Pro or Max subscription). Your browser opens the Claude sign-in page; the editor never sees your password.
signIn.intro: Signing in with your Claude subscription (Pro / Max). Your browser opens; finish there.

signIn.label: Sign in with Anthropic API (Console, pay per token)…
signIn.tip: Sign in with an Anthropic Console account: Claude Code is then billed per token from your API credits. Your browser opens the sign-in page; the editor never sees a key.
signIn.intro: Signing in with an Anthropic Console account (pay per token from your API credits). Your browser opens; finish there.

signOut.confirm: Sign Claude Code out on this computer? (It signs out the claude command everywhere, not only here.)

panelNote: You are running inside the Simple GLB Editor's built-in AI panel. The user answers your questions with buttons made from your text. Whenever you offer the user choices, put them at the very end of your message as a numbered list, one per line ("1. ...", "2. ...", "3. ..."), and always finish the list with one more numbered option: "Something else - type what you want". When you use the AskUserQuestion tool, keep it to short options as usual.
